description: Standalone calendar display with rich cell content

attributes.name: data-month
attributes.description: Month to display (1-12). Defaults to the current month. Observed; reflected back as the view changes.

attributes.name: data-year
attributes.description: Year to display. Defaults to the current year. Observed; reflected back as the view changes.

attributes.name: data-events
attributes.description: JSON: events keyed by start ISO date. Values may be a string, an object, or an array of events. Each event accepts optional `end` (ISO date, inclusive) or `days` (count) to span multiple days; spans render as continuous bars in data-size="large". Observed: changes re-render and fire calendar-wc:events-changed with source "attribute".

attributes.name: data-highlight-dates
attributes.description: Comma-separated ISO dates to highlight (optionally with :category)

attributes.name: data-months
attributes.description: Number of adjacent months to display side by side (1-12). Defaults to 1.

attributes.name: data-year-range
attributes.description: Years listed either side of the current year in the year select (0-200). data-min-date / data-max-date bound that side instead, and the displayed year is always listed.

attributes.name: data-heading-level
attributes.description: Multi-month views: render each month title as <h1>-<h6> at this level. Default: plain text (no heading).

attributes.name: data-label-more
attributes.description: Large-view overflow text; {n} is replaced with the hidden event count.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form participation name. Enables ElementInternals form value sync on selection.

attributes.name: data-tentative
attributes.description: Range mode: the ISO start date while the second click is pending. Removed when the range completes.

events.name: calendar:select
events.detail: { value, date } (single) | { value, start, end, startDate, endDate } (range) | { values, dates } (multi)

events.name: calendar:day-open
events.description: Fired when the day-detail dialog opens (display mode)

events.name: calendar-wc:events-changed
events.description: Fired after the event data changes via the events property or the data-events attribute

properties.name: value
properties.description: Read-only selection: ISO date (single), ISO interval start/end (range), space-separated ISO dates (multi), or null

properties.name: events
properties.description: Get the date-keyed event map, or assign a date-keyed object or flat array (grouped by date) to re-render; fires calendar-wc:events-changed with source 'property'

properties.name: isDateDisallowed
properties.description: Callback; return true to disable a date. Additive with data-min/max-date and data-disabled-dates

properties.name: getDayParts
properties.description: Callback; returned tokens are set as data-day-part on the cell's <td>

methods.name: refresh()
methods.description: Re-render the current view (e.g. after data read by a callback changes)

childAttributes.name: data-date
childAttributes.description: ISO date of an in-month day button (runtime)

childAttributes.name: data-day
childAttributes.description: Day-of-month number on every day button, including outside-month ones (runtime)

childAttributes.name: aria-selected
childAttributes.description: Selection state of the gridcell in selection modes (runtime)

childAttributes.name: data-outside-month
childAttributes.description: Leading/trailing day from an adjacent month (runtime)

childAttributes.name: data-events
childAttributes.description: Cell has at least one event (runtime)

childAttributes.name: data-event-count
childAttributes.description: Number of events covering the day, spans included (runtime)

childAttributes.name: data-row-lanes
childAttributes.description: Large view: number of span-bar lanes in the row (runtime)

childAttributes.name: data-event-dot
childAttributes.description: One event dot in compact/default views (runtime)

childAttributes.name: data-continues-start
childAttributes.description: Span bar continues from the previous row (runtime)

childAttributes.name: data-continues-end
childAttributes.description: Span bar continues into the next row (runtime)
